name: secure-software
description: Offensive and defensive, evidence-driven security engineering for software and infrastructure.

interface.longDescription: Attack, emulate, reverse, protect, threat-model, audit, validate, and harden websites, APIs, services, desktop and mobile apps, cloud and IAM, CI/CD, containers, operating systems, dependencies, and deployed software. The workflow produces working proofs, reconstructs binaries and protocols, normalizes crash and runtime paths, and applies measured artifact protection or root-boundary remediation when requested.
defaultPrompt: Reverse this supplied target, build and run the smallest working exploit proof, and trace the full attack chain.
Run a deep security audit and validate findings from entry point to impact.
Design and verify a stable cross-language protection pipeline for this shipped application.
